Title: Roleplay Save System Overhaul
Description:
This mod makes it easier to save and allows you to keep multiple saves throughout one playthrough.

[h1]Features[/h1]
- On every [i]roleplay[/i] or [i]wander[/i] checkpoint, a copy (identified based on the turn) is saved to the game run's save directory; they are deleted together with other save files on save delete
- You can see all previous checkpoints and load them in the "Continue" menu when you click [L] or the "save list" button
- Since it saves copies, it doesn't impact your existing Primary saves
- Adds a new "checkpoint" wish
- Allows you to checkpoint outside settlements, after cooking or relaxing by the fireplace

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
This mod uses Harmony prefixes and postfixes to modify existing classes like the "Continue" screen, Checkpoint logic and Campfire actions. Since postfixes/prefixes can stack it shouldn't cause issues unless the other mod can't tolerate extra files in the saves folder. Let me know about any technical issues you come across in the comments.

[h2]Warning[/h2]
This mod saves every checkpoint you make as a separate file. If you're saving disk space, you can go to your Save Folder (Main Menu → Modding Toolkit → Open Save Folder → Synced → Saves).
Delete old files starting with [i]zbrek_RoleplaySaveSystemOverhaul[/i].
They're copies and can be safely discarded – your main save is the [i]Primary[/i] file.
